label: Bible Study
prompt: Neither shall thy name any more be called Abram, but thy name shall be Abraham; for a father of many _____ have I made thee.
verse: Neither shall thy name any more be called Abram, but thy name shall be Abraham; for a father of many nations have I made thee.
note: A new name for a man still waiting on a son — Abram becomes Abraham, and the name itself is a promise.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And the LORD said unto him, Peace be unto thee; fear not: thou shalt not _____.
verse: And the LORD said unto him, Peace be unto thee; fear not: thou shalt not die.
note: Gideon panics after seeing the angel face to face; God calms him: peace, fear not, thou shalt not die.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And it came to pass, when the evil spirit from God was upon Saul, that David took an _____, and played with his hand: so Saul was refreshed, and was well, and the evil spirit departed from him.
verse: And it came to pass, when the evil spirit from God was upon Saul, that David took an harp, and played with his hand: so Saul was refreshed, and was well, and the evil spirit departed from him.
note: Before he was a giant-slayer, David was Saul's personal musician, soothing the troubled king with his harp.

label: Deep Water
prompt: But though we, or an angel from heaven, preach any other gospel unto you than that which we have preached unto you, let him be _____.
verse: But though we, or an angel from heaven, preach any other gospel unto you than that which we have preached unto you, let him be accursed.
note: Paul even includes himself and angels — the gospel's content outranks any messenger's credentials.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: And he stood between the dead and the living; and the plague was _____.
verse: And he stood between the dead and the living; and the plague was stayed.
note: Aaron ran with his censer and 'stood between the dead and the living; and the plague was stayed.' Intercession on the run.
